text_block_list.text: ――One day near the end of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... do you happen to know
where Stego-senpai is?
choice_data_list: I don't know yet, but... did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, we gathered together
to set off fireworks at the end of training camp!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And so, I thought I'd invite you along too, Stego-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might know
where they are, Trainer, but...
Oh dear, what should I do...!
choice_data_list: It's just a guess, but if it's Stego—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —...Oh, Trainer, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what?
Suzuka and the others are coming too?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-Incredible!
It was really there...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
“—I see.
And so you turned to your Trainer for help.”

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm surprised.
To think you'd guess the location on the first try—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Walking forward without a shred of hesitation,
as if guided by an invisible red string~

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How on earth did you know that!?
Is there some habit of Stego-san's
that only you know, Trainer!?
choice_data_list: No, I just had a hunch it might be here...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You mean it was just a hunch!?
Surely you can't be—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Well, wouldn't you know it, that's probably how it is.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You're my traveling companion, Trainer.
That's reason enough, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...That's so like our senpais.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ――Alright, next up, let's take on this extra-large one~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...!
It is truly breathtaking...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It goes up higher than I thought...
...So pretty—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Since we're at it, might as well
tack on the ones I put over here too.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I-Isn't that way too much?!
Wait—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyowah!?
It's already on fire, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright, everyone stand back~. Here goes~.
(B-B-B-B-B-B-B-B-B-B-BAAAANG!!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Now this is incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"—Hehehe!
My sparkler has incredible stamina, you know~!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, I will not lose~.
Making a sparkler last as long as possible
happens to be one of my specialties~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wait, this was a contest...?
choice_data_list: ...Are you sure you don't want to join in?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Right here is fine.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe it's because I'm aiming for the center of this era.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...I can feel the breath of those who walked the same era with me
somehow closer than ever before."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: And so, I can't help but think—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I figured it might be nice to try doing more things in this world that I can only do with them.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"To show the pride of our generation.
...Something like that, maybe?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This is a story about 'memories,' but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
By the time I battled against Opera O's generation in the next year's Tenno Sho (Autumn),
not a single familiar face from my own generation was left there...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, all things are impermanent, after all.
Transitioning to a new generation is inherently inevitable.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Still, in this life—... they are hale and hearty.
Perhaps the changing of the guard, and my lonely battle,
can both be rewritten."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"If we could pull that off...
Wouldn't it be pretty interesting?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'll try carrying a bit of it on my shoulders. You know, this "generation" thing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"And on top of that, if one of those guys
happens to run alongside me—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Displaying our pride together sounds rather intriguing as well.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Which "memory" do you think
would be more interesting for me to fight against?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Then should I challenge them head-on? The Golden Generation—
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Boy oh boy, Spe-chan sure is giving it her all, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Because Sei-chan, King-chan, and Tsuru-chan
are running in the Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I don't intend to lose to anyone in our generation,
or anyone else, for that matter!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh boy~...
Her switch is totally flipped now. What a pain, what a pain.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —Glad to see you're fired up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Stego-san......!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...The next Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And there, I intend to compete against you all
as a representative of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Will you accept, Spe?
This challenge.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Just when I think she's drifting along with the wind,
she suddenly drops something like that on me...
I really can't read this woman at all~..."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I'm going out there to win as a proud representative of my generation!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Umm, as for me...
I'll just be taking things at my own pace~

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, I don't mind at all. The best thing is for all of you to run true to yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I shall look forward to it.

...And so, it arrives.
The autumn where all destinies converge――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Someone from our class is bound to enter the next Tenno Sho (Autumn) too.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Together with that, we'll clash head-on against Opera O and the others—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll flashily prove that things are different from those "memories."
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
Not bad, Top Road-san!
You seem to shine even brighter after this summer!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much...!
Though this is all thanks to Opera-chan too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You keep getting stronger at a terrifying pace, and feeling like I have to catch up to you... really sets my soul on fire!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit.
Keep this up and continue to add color to my Path of Supremacy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Uhyooo...! A classic, emotional rivalry scene playing out under the twilight sky...!
It's even more dazzling than the setting sun—so preciousss...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Umm... Digital-san.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Gyahhh!? D-D-D-Doto-san!?
How long have you been standing there!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, it's been going on for a little while, but...
Digital-san looked like she wanted to say something to Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah... ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, the truth is... since we'll be running together
in the Tenno Sho (Autumn) soon,
I thought I'd come say hello, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it was presumptuous of me after all.
I mean, when I got here, you two were running side by side looking so dazzling and all. So I just, without thinking—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
――!!
Sensing an ultra-rare Umamusume-chan aura!!
This mysterious, mystical air is...!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yo.
Opera O, Top Road.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
S-Stay Gold-san...!!
Whoaaa...! This three-shot is way too dazzling,
I can't handle itttt...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Stego-san.
...You have a somewhat different air about you today.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "I thought you were a traveler because you were bound by nothing, but—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"I can carry it once in a while.
I happen to treasure the things I pick up along my journey, you know."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...The next Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And there, I intend to compete against you all
as a representative of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Will you accept? This challenge.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ho—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge!
I want to compete with you, Stego-san,
with the determination to carry our generation!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha.
Always quick on the uptake, Top Road."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
The Overlord turns no one away.
I welcome any and all challenges!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Show off your pride to your heart's content, Stego-san.
As the conqueror of our generation,
I'll face you head-on without holding back!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's settled.
...All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Digital! Doto!
I'm looking forward to running with you two as well!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes...!
As part of the same generation as Opera O-san...!
I-I'll do my b-best...!!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: They totally recognized meeeee~~~~~~......―――

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: D-Digital-san?!

...And so, it arrives.
The autumn where all destinies converge――
